# Geant4 11.4.0 for Windows x64

This product includes software developed by Members of the Geant4 Collaboration (http://cern.ch/geant4).

The build fetches the Windows SDK, matching Geant4 source and the G4EMLOW 8.8, G4ENSDFSTATE 3.0, PhotonEvaporation 6.1.2 and RealSurface 2.2 datasets. Every archive is checked against its pinned SHA-256 before use. The shared cache retains the original archives for other checkouts and offline builds. The portable application contains the compiled runtime, datasets, notices and corresponding source and runs independently of this cache.

The [bundle manifest](bundle.json) records the upstream locations and digests. The [offline component catalogue](../../legal/public/index.json) supplies the original notices. G4EMLOW is restricted to non-commercial use within Geant4. The datasets, SDK components and Microsoft runtime retain their respective terms. The corresponding Geant4 source accompanies the portable distribution as well. [Geant4 license](https://geant4.web.cern.ch/download/license.html) · [Upstream release](https://geant4.web.cern.ch/download/11.4.0.html)
